name: Grinding keeper, 1/8 x 1/2 x 1-1/2 in
model: 1/8 x 1/2 in precision ground O-1 flat stock, cut 1-1/2 in long
description: A short ground steel strip laid flat on the surface grinder's magnetic chuck, set tight against a part too weakly magnetic or too small for the chuck to hold alone: the magnet holds the keeper, and the keepers trap the part. Three in a pinwheel block in ct-tpg322's carbide insert.

key_specs.name: Length
key_specs.note: proposed: cut from the 18 in bar so a pinwheel of three round a 3/8 in IC triangle reaches 23 mm behind it and 35 in front, inside the chuck and clear of the spindle's housing with the 6 in wheel at the work

key_specs.name: Hold on the grinder's chuck
key_specs.note: its 1/2 x 1-1/2 in face at the chuck's rated 20.7 N/cm2 (moonshot/library/stations/sgrind.json chuck)
